blocked_candidates.reason: Education obligation is not universal mandatory school attendance; the historical law also had phased implementation and exceptions.
Support is not conditional on joint parental consent; education authorities make statutory support decisions.
Consultation does not mean parents jointly decide every assessment or retention decision.
The regional state administrative agency named in the source ceased operating in 2026; the oversight authority changed.
The 1–5 scale applies to initial vocational qualifications; further and specialist qualifications use pass/fail.
Completing the general upper secondary syllabus alone is not a universal university eligibility credential. University and UAS rules differ.
The categorical exclusion of study-based immigrants omits EU-worker and related exceptions.
FPA approves participating restaurants; institution ownership is not the eligibility criterion.
Permanent residence alone does not make every degree programme free; language, status and programme matter.
The unconditional nearest-school guarantee is too broad; the municipality assigns an appropriate school and support.
The source uses the old individualization framework without the safeguards and decisions in the 2025–2026 support reform.
Earlier compulsory education replaced the old extended-compulsory-education arrangement from August 2026.
The six-year-old statement conflates preschool, compulsory education and school start under the old framework.
The source conflates an IP plan with a special-support decision and uses terminology replaced by the support reform.

verification_sources.findings: 2025–2026 support reform and continuing right to appropriate learning support.
Transition deadline August 2026 and earlier compulsory education; parental consent is not a prerequisite for statutory support.
Practical demonstration and the distinction between initial qualification numerical grades and further/specialist pass/fail.
Housing supplement eligibility, study-month limitation and exceptions.
Private care conditions and payment directly to provider; no entitlement for municipal care.
Right begins in calendar month of nine-month age.
Municipal childcare fee factors; no current euro amount tested.
Childcare forms, language support and parent cooperation.
Paid apprenticeship versus non-employment training agreement, individual planning and workplace demonstrations.
Minimum five matriculation tests and conditional S2/R2 alternative; card does not imply universal eligibility.
Compulsory education and free secondary education; card limited to ordinary eligible young learners.
Free education normally extends through calendar year of turning twenty, not simply until eighteen.
Preparatory objectives, maximum year and flexible transition.
Higher UAS normally requires two years relevant experience; arts exceptions retained through normally.
University/UAS distinction and conditional international tuition fees and scholarships.
At least ten days, distance and statutory free-education entitlement; the card expressly preserves other conditions.
Meal subsidy entitlement and accepted student or meal-subsidy card.
Subsidized meals at participating restaurants; source ownership restriction rejected.
Foreign-student eligibility and EU family-worker exceptions; residency card is not sole criterion.
Student aid requires qualifying studies and individual eligibility.
Conditional work right under a student permit; no unqualified unrestricted-work claim.
EU work rights and student-permit work conditions.
Schools must address absence; assessment compares competence with objectives, not absence alone.
Transport eligibility requires an application and conditions; local rules can be more generous. No ambiguous daily round-trip threshold tested.
Celia still provides accessible learning materials; no guarantee that every title exists as an audiobook.
Accessible upper-secondary materials confirmed.
Full-time study and age-seventeen normal study-grant starting point; earlier grant possible if child benefit cancelled.
Labour-market training goals, free participation and conditional expense reimbursement.
Vocational study, individual planning and fees depend on qualification and entitlement.
State guarantee followed by bank application.
Borrower repayment obligation remains even when the guarantee is invoked.
Approved integration-plan language study within liberal adult education can be free.

other_source_issues.reason: Under-eighteen free-material statement is not an exclusive upper age limit; card avoids implying that it is.
Every institution has a scholarship system is too absolute; card says inquire with the institution.
IP terminology may conflate vocational individual planning; PUK is used for the selected plan question.

coverage_note: Source IDs include context and consolidation links. Coverage concerns selected learning points, not every detail in every linked sentence. Source itself was preserved. CORE priorities were not reduced for obsolete claims.
